words.ex: I have to admit, you were right.
use: He admitted his mistake right away.
I hate to admit it, but I was wrong.
mcq: I admit to be late yesterday.
He admitted that he forgot the meeting.
She admitted me her secret plan.
They admitted for the problem.
words.note: admit + that절 또는 admit + -ing. 'admit to be'는 틀린 형태예요.

words.ex: I like her positive attitude.
use: His attitude toward work changed completely.
일을 대하는 그의 태도가 완전히 달라졌다.
mcq: He has a good attitude toward learning.
He has a good attitude to learn English fastly.
His attitude is very learn.
He attituded well in class.
words.note: attitude toward/to + 명사 형태로 씁니다. attitude는 동사로 쓰지 않아요.

words.ex: Can I borrow your pen for a second?
use: I borrowed some money from my brother.
You can borrow up to five books.
책을 다섯 권까지 빌릴 수 있어요.
mcq: Can you borrow me your charger?
I borrowed him my umbrella.
Can I borrow your charger?
She borrowed a pen to me.
words.note: borrow는 '내가 빌려오다'. 남에게 빌려주는 건 lend예요. 'borrow me'는 한국식 오류!

words.ex: Small shops can't compete with big malls.
words.exko: 작은 가게는 대형 몰과 경쟁이 안 돼요.
use: Five teams are competing for first place.
mcq: We compete against three other companies.
We compete to three other companies.
We are competing about the prize.
They competed us last year.
words.note: compete with/against + 상대, compete for + 목표물. compete to는 없어요.

words.ex: Please confirm your reservation by Friday.
use: I'm calling to confirm my appointment.
The hotel confirmed my booking by email.
mcq: Can you confirm me the schedule?
Can you confirm the schedule?
Please confirm about your attendance.
He confirmed to the meeting time.
words.note: confirm + 목적어 바로 연결. 'confirm me', 'confirm about'은 어색해요.

words.ex: The flight was delayed by two hours.
use: Let's not delay the decision any longer.
mcq: The meeting delayed because of him.
The meeting was delayed because of the weather.
We delayed to start the project.
The train is delaying now.
words.note: 주어가 지연되는 쪽이면 be delayed(수동). delay + -ing도 가능하지만 delay to는 안 돼요.

words.ex: You deserve a break after all that work.
mcq: You deserve to relax this weekend.
You deserve relaxing this weekend.
You are deserved a vacation.
This deserves for attention.
words.note: deserve + to부정사 또는 deserve + 명사. 수동태로 잘 안 쓰고 deserve for도 없어요.

words.ex: I don't want to disappoint my parents.
use: I was disappointed with the result.
mcq: I disappointed about the news.
The result disappointed to me.
I was disappointed with the service.
The service was disappointed.
words.note: 사람이 실망하면 be disappointed with/by. 사물이 주어면 disappointing(실망스러운)이에요.

words.ex: My employer pays for my health insurance.
use: She's looking for a new employer.
My previous employer was a small startup.
mcq: My employer gave us a bonus this year.
My employer is working at Samsung.
I am an employer at this company.
My employer job is difficult.
words.note: employer는 고용하는 쪽(회사·사장). 고용된 직원은 employee! 한 글자 차이 조심.

words.ex: My teacher encouraged me to keep trying.
use: The company encourages employees to take breaks.
Her success encouraged me a lot.
mcq: He encouraged me to apply for the job.
He encouraged me applying the job.
He encouraged that I apply.
He encouraged to me strongly.
words.note: encourage + 사람 + to부정사가 기본 틀이에요.

words.ex: Can you give me an estimate for the repair?
words.exko: 수리 견적 좀 내주실 수 있나요?
use: We estimate the project will take three months.
프로젝트에 석 달 정도 걸릴 것으로 추정한다.
The estimated cost is around 2 million won.
mcq: I estimate about the price wrongly.
We estimate that it will cost more.
The cost estimates expensive.
He estimated to finish early.
words.note: estimate + that절 / estimate + 명사. estimate about은 어색해요.

words.ex: The company plans to expand into Asia.
use: We're expanding our business next year.
mcq: The company expanded its market share.
The company expanded up the new market.
They expanded more bigger last year.
The business is expand now.
words.note: expand + 목적어 또는 expand into + 지역/분야. expand up은 없어요.

words.ex: I need to install the new app first.
use: They installed a security camera at the entrance.
The update will be installed automatically.
mcq: Please install the program on your computer.
Please install the program in yourself.
The program installed me quickly.
I installed to the new version.
words.note: install A on B(기기) 형태가 기본이에요.

words.ex: We're still negotiating the price.
use: 그녀는 연봉을 더 높게 협상해 냈다.
The two sides are negotiating with each other.
mcq: We negotiated about with them the contract.
We negotiated the contract with them.
We negotiated them the contract.
They negotiated to the price.
words.note: negotiate + 대상 + with + 상대. negotiate to는 안 써요.

words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
use: I'd prefer to stay home tonight.
오늘 밤은 집에 있는 게 더 좋겠어.
mcq: I prefer coffee than tea.
I prefer coffee to tea.
I prefer coffee from tea.
I more prefer coffee better.
words.note: prefer A to B! than이 아니라 to를 쓰는 게 포인트예요.

words.ex: Regular exercise prevents many diseases.
use: The rain prevented us from leaving.
How can we prevent this from happening again?
이런 일이 재발하지 않게 하려면 어떻게 해야 할까?
mcq: The noise prevented me to sleep.
The noise prevented me from sleeping.
The noise prevented that I sleep.
The noise prevented my sleep from.
words.note: prevent + 사람 + from + -ing. 'prevent to'는 한국인이 가장 많이 틀리는 형태!

words.ex: You can purchase tickets online.
mcq: I purchased a new laptop last week.
I purchased for a new laptop.
I did purchase shopping yesterday.
The laptop was purchase by me.
words.note: purchase + 목적어 바로 연결. buy보다 격식 있는 말이라 비즈니스에서 자주 써요.

words.ex: Can you recommend a good restaurant?
use: The doctor recommended getting more sleep.
mcq: I recommend you to this cafe strongly.
I recommend this cafe.
I recommend to this cafe.
This cafe is recommend.
words.note: recommend + 명사/-ing가 자연스러워요. 'recommend you to 장소'는 어색합니다.

words.ex: Remind me to call her tomorrow.
use: This song reminds me of my school days.
이 노래를 들으면 학창 시절이 생각나.
I reminded him about the deadline.
mcq: This photo reminds me of our trip.
This photo remembers me our trip.
This photo reminds to me our trip.
I remind this photo of the trip.
words.note: remind A of B = A에게 B를 떠올리게 하다. remember(기억하다)와 혼동 주의!

words.ex: Can you translate this into Korean?
words.exko: 이거 한국어로 번역해 줄 수 있어요?
use: She translates novels for a living.
The sign was translated into five languages.
mcq: Please translate this sentence to English by Korean.
Please translate this sentence into English.
Please translate English this sentence.
This sentence translates me easily.
words.note: translate A into B(언어). from A into B로 출발 언어도 붙일 수 있어요.
